\[
(f \bullet B) - f
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The image
- \(B\): The structuring element

The closing fills every dark detail the element does not fit into, so the difference keeps only those dark details, as bright values. Erosion takes the smallest value of f(p + z) for z in B. Dilation takes the largest value of f(p - z), which uses the element turned by 180 degrees. Both match the grayscale erosion and dilation of SciPy. On an image of 0 and 255 they are binary erosion and dilation.
